title: Comrades Marathon FAQs — qualification, prizes, race pack collection
claims: The qualifying standards are 42.2 km in 4:59:59 or faster, 48 km in 5:59:59, 50 km in 6:09:59, 52–54 km in 6:29:59, 56 km in 6:59:59, 60 km in 7:39:59, 64 km in 8:14:59, 80 km in 10:34:59, 90 km in 11:59:59 and 100 km in 13:34:59.
The entry fee is waived for runners who have completed 25 or more Comrades Marathons.

Top-10 prize money is R1,000,000 for first, R575,300 for second, R413,900 for third, R208,200 for fourth, R163,700 for fifth, R94,800 for sixth, R83,100 for seventh, R72,500 for eighth, R62,000 for ninth and R49,200 for tenth.
Race pack collection for 2027 runs on 10 June 10:00–19:00, 11 June 09:00–19:00 and 12 June 09:00–16:00, at the Durban Exhibition Centre or Comrades House in Pietermaritzburg.

General ballot applications closed on 22 September 2026 at 16:30; the initial draw was on 23 September, payment processing on 25–26 September, and a redraw if required on 28 September with payment on 29–30 September.
Entries are non-transferable and non-refundable, may not be sold or transferred except through the official substitution process, and may not be deferred to a future race.
The extended 2027 prize money schedule will be published once confirmed.
